name: Kagami Seiji
source:
A rich boy that was bored of his uneventful life. One day, while strolling around the city, he finds [url=/c6868]Mizuhara Takumi[/url] raping [url=/c6870]Haruse Ayaka[/url]. The girl screams and her pained face awakens Seiji's darker desires.
He befriends Takumi, who teaches Seiji, gives him a list of targets and sometimes helps him.
